title: Gantt
empty: Nothing is scheduled in this window.
undated: {count, plural, one {# issue has no dates and can't be drawn} other {# issues have no dates and can't be drawn}}
truncated: Only as much as this window holds is drawn. Narrow the range.
linksOutside: {count, plural, one {# dependency points outside this window} other {# dependencies point outside this window}}
linksOutsideHint: Widen the range to bring those issues in.
conflicts: {count, plural, one {# dependency is out of order} other {# dependencies are out of order}}
conflictsHint: Work that should come later starts before the work it follows. Fix the dates or the link.
conflictRow: {successor} follows {predecessor} — {days, plural, one {# day overlap} other {# days overlap}}
filterHint: Narrows within the project. Example: assignee = currentUser()
